mentions.name: Dual-machine dual-monitor app development setup
mentions.description: A development workspace that links two monitors to two machines—one to a Mac for iOS app development and one to a Windows laptop for Android—so both mobile platforms can be developed for simultaneously instead of one at a time.
mentions.problem: Previously limited to developing for one mobile platform at a time on a single machine.
mentions.source_excerpt: Now I have 2 monitors, one linked to my Mac and the other to my Windows laptop. This way I can simultaneously develop for both platforms at the same time.

evidence.value: Now I have 2 monitors, one linked to my Mac and the other to my Windows laptop. This way I can simultaneously develop for both platforms at the same time.
